title: The Members list and the Money collections list draw every row at once
what: The Members page puts every member on screen in one go (a card each on a phone, a table row each on a computer), and filters and re-sorts the whole list again on every letter typed in the search box. Money, Collections does the same for every receipt in the chosen dates, so a custom range of a year at a 500-member gym draws thousands of rows. On a cheap desk phone these pages get slow to open and typing in the search lags as the gym grows.
expected: Long lists show the first screenful or a page at a time (or only draw what is on screen), and the search waits for a short pause in typing before it filters.
who: owners and desk staff of bigger gyms
how_often: every time the page opens or a letter is typed
fix_line: Show long lists a page at a time and wait for a pause before searching

title: The Trainers page downloads every trainer's photo again each time the week changes or a session is booked
what: Trainer photos travel inside the week's schedule answer, as text of up to about 140 KB each, instead of as separate pictures the browser can keep. Every move to the next or previous week, every booking, every cancel and every Refresh fetches the whole answer again, photos included. A gym with 8 trainers sends close to a megabyte per tap over slow 4G, and the page waits for it before showing the new week.
expected: Photos are fetched once and kept by the browser; changing the week or booking only fetches the bookings.
who: owners and trainers using the Trainers page
how_often: every week change, booking or cancel
fix_line: Send trainer photos once as pictures and leave them out of the week's bookings read
